segments.title: A circuit needs a place
segments.text: A circuit can be logically correct, yet still need a physical home. Where should its cells go on a chip?
segments.zh: 一个电路在逻辑上正确，还不等于它已经有了合适的物理位置。这些单元应该放在芯片的哪里？
segments.en: A circuit can be logically correct, yet still need a physical home. Where should its cells go on a chip?

segments.title: Connections need distance
segments.text: Think of a tiny city. Buildings need addresses, and connections need routes. Placement chooses positions before those detailed routes are drawn.
segments.zh: 把它想成一座微型城市。建筑需要地址，连接需要路线。布局先决定位置，详细的布线路径稍后再来安排。
segments.en: Think of a tiny city. Buildings need addresses, and connections need routes. Placement chooses positions before those detailed routes are drawn.

segments.title: A place in the flow
segments.text: Floorplanning sets the broad arrangement. Placement positions cells. Legalization resolves physical placement rules, and routing builds the detailed connections.
segments.zh: 布图规划确定总体安排，布局确定单元位置，合法化处理物理摆放规则，布线再建立具体连接。
segments.en: Floorplanning sets the broad arrangement. Placement positions cells. Legalization resolves physical placement rules, and routing builds the detailed connections.

segments.title: Shorter is tempting
segments.text: Short connections sound attractive. But squeezing connected cells together can create another problem: too many cells competing for the same space.
segments.zh: 短连接听起来很诱人。但把相连的单元挤在一起，也会制造另一个问题：太多单元争抢同一块空间。
segments.en: Short connections sound attractive. But squeezing connected cells together can create another problem: too many cells competing for the same space.

segments.title: Our six-point circuit
segments.text: Let us shrink the problem to six points, A through F. In this teaching model, a point represents a cell or terminal.
segments.zh: 我们先把问题缩小成 A 到 F 六个点。在这个教学模型里，一个点代表一个单元或者端点。
segments.en: Let us shrink the problem to six points, A through F. In this teaching model, a point represents a cell or terminal.

segments.title: What is a net?
segments.text: A net is a group of terminals that must connect. Most nets here join two points; one joins A, B, C and D.
segments.zh: 一个连接网络，简称 net，就是必须连接在一起的一组端点。这里大多数网络连接两个点，还有一个同时连接 A、B、C、D。
segments.en: A net is a group of terminals that must connect. Most nets here join two points; one joins A, B, C and D.

segments.title: Some points stay put
segments.text: A and D are fixed anchors. We may move B, C, E and F, but a lower score must not come from moving the anchors.
segments.zh: A 和 D 是固定锚点。B、C、E、F 可以移动，但不能靠偷偷移动锚点来换取更低的分数。
segments.en: A and D are fixed anchors. We may move B, C, E and F, but a lower score must not come from moving the anchors.

segments.title: A model, with limits
segments.text: Real cells have width, height and placement rules. Our points leave those details out, so this experiment is not a legalization check.
segments.zh: 真实单元有宽、高以及摆放规则。点模型省略了这些细节，所以这个实验并不是在检查真实单元是否已经合法摆放。
segments.en: Real cells have width, height and placement rules. Our points leave those details out, so this experiment is not a legalization check.

segments.title: Draw the smallest box
segments.text: How can we estimate connection length quickly? Start with net B to D. Draw the smallest axis-aligned box containing both endpoints.
segments.zh: 怎样快速估计连接长度？先看 B 到 D 这个网络，画出包住两个端点的最小、边与坐标轴平行的矩形。
segments.en: How can we estimate connection length quickly? Start with net B to D. Draw the smallest axis-aligned box containing both endpoints.

segments.title: Width plus height
segments.text: Its width is seven, and its height is seven. Add them: fourteen. This is the half-perimeter wirelength, usually called H P W L.
segments.zh: 矩形宽为七，高也为七。两者相加得到十四。这就是半周长线长，通常简称 H P W L。
segments.en: Its width is seven, and its height is seven. Add them: fourteen. This is the half-perimeter wirelength, usually called H P W L.

segments.title: More than two terminals
segments.text: For a multi-terminal net, the rule is unchanged. Find the leftmost, rightmost, lowest and highest terminals; add the box's width and height.
segments.zh: 对于多个端点的网络，规则不变。找出最左、最右、最低和最高的端点，再把包围盒的宽与高相加。
segments.en: For a multi-terminal net, the rule is unchanged. Find the leftmost, rightmost, lowest and highest terminals; add the box's width and height.

segments.title: A useful surprise
segments.text: Watch an interior terminal move while the extremes stay fixed. The box does not change, so this net's estimate does not change either.
segments.zh: 观察一个内部端点移动，而四个方向的极值保持不变。包围盒没有变化，这个网络的线长估计也就没有变化。
segments.en: Watch an interior terminal move while the extremes stay fixed. The box does not change, so this net's estimate does not change either.

segments.title: Add every net
segments.text: Repeat for all six nets and add the estimates. In this crowded arrangement, the total is forty-eight point five, not fourteen.
segments.zh: 对全部六个网络重复计算，再把结果相加。在这个拥挤布局中，总估计线长是四十八点五，而不是十四。
segments.en: Repeat for all six nets and add the estimates. In this crowded arrangement, the total is forty-eight point five, not fourteen.

segments.title: Estimate, not routed wire
segments.text: H P W L is a convenient estimate, not a finished wire route. It does not capture every obstacle or detailed routing constraint.
segments.zh: H P W L 是一种方便的估计，并不是已经完成的布线路径。它没有包含全部障碍物和详细布线约束。
segments.en: H P W L is a convenient estimate, not a finished wire route. It does not capture every obstacle or detailed routing constraint.

segments.title: Divide the space
segments.text: Now give space a score. Divide the placement area into four regions, often called bins. Count how many points fall in each region.
segments.zh: 现在给空间使用情况也打个分。把布局区域划成四个小区域，常称为 bin，再数一数每个区域里有多少点。
segments.en: Now give space a score. Divide the placement area into four regions, often called bins. Count how many points fall in each region.

segments.title: Two places per region
segments.text: For this first comparison, each region has capacity two. The colour shows occupancy, not temperature, and the fixed points count as well.
segments.zh: 在第一个对照示例中，每个区域的容量是二。颜色表示占用情况，不表示温度。固定点也计入数量。
segments.en: For this first comparison, each region has capacity two. The colour shows occupancy, not temperature, and the fixed points count as well.

segments.title: Count the extras
segments.text: Five points share the lower-left region. Two fit and three are extra. Add all such extras across the regions to get total overflow.
segments.zh: 左下区域里挤着五个点，容量够放两个，多出三个。把各区域超出的数量相加，就是总溢出量 overflow。
segments.en: Five points share the lower-left region. Two fit and three are extra. Add all such extras across the regions to get total overflow.

segments.title: Make a prediction
segments.text: If we spread the points into available space, what will happen to the wirelength estimate? Take a moment to make your prediction.
segments.zh: 如果把这些点分散到有空位的区域，估计线长会怎样变化？先停一小会儿，做出你的预测。
segments.en: If we spread the points into available space, what will happen to the wirelength estimate? Take a moment to make your prediction.

segments.title: Make a little room
segments.text: Here is one possible arrangement. Every region now fits. Overflow falls from three to zero, while estimated wirelength rises to fifty-two.
segments.zh: 这里是一种可能的安排。每个区域现在都放得下，溢出从三降到零，而估计线长升到了五十二。
segments.en: Here is one possible arrangement. Every region now fits. Overflow falls from three to zero, while estimated wirelength rises to fifty-two.

segments.title: Read both scores
segments.text: That is a trade-off. If capacity is a requirement, shorter wires alone are not enough. This is a designed comparison, not an algorithm run.
segments.zh: 这就是一种取舍。如果容量限制必须满足，仅仅让线更短是不够的。这是手工设计的对照，不是算法的运行轨迹。
segments.en: That is a trade-off. If capacity is a requirement, shorter wires alone are not enough. This is a designed comparison, not an algorithm run.

segments.title: Enter the course experiment
segments.text: Now switch to the course experiment. It uses the same six-point netlist and fixed anchors, but capacity is one per region. Notice the changed label.
segments.zh: 现在切换到课程原实验。六点网络和固定锚点保持相同，但每个区域的容量改为一。注意画面上变化后的标签。
segments.en: Now switch to the course experiment. It uses the same six-point netlist and fixed anchors, but capacity is one per region. Notice the changed label.

segments.title: Three moves in a loop
segments.text: The small teaching placer first pulls connected points together, then spreads overcrowded regions. A gentle reconnection step follows each spreading step.
segments.zh: 这个小型教学布局器先拉近相连的点，再疏散过于拥挤的区域。每次疏散后，都紧接着进行一次轻度的重新连接。
segments.en: The small teaching placer first pulls connected points together, then spreads overcrowded regions. A gentle reconnection step follows each spreading step.

segments.title: Follow the connections
segments.text: The first six updates pull movable points towards their neighbours, with a small centring term. A and D remain locked throughout.
segments.zh: 前六次更新把可动点拉向相邻点，同时带有一个较小的居中项。整个过程中，A 和 D 都保持锁定。
segments.en: The first six updates pull movable points towards their neighbours, with a small centring term. A and D remain locked throughout.

segments.title: Smooth the positions
segments.text: Three further averaging updates refine the wirelength stage. You need not solve a large equation to follow the idea: connected points influence each other's positions.
segments.zh: 随后再用三次平均更新细化线长优化阶段。不必先会解大型方程，也能理解这个想法：相连的点会影响彼此的位置。
segments.en: Three further averaging updates refine the wirelength stage. You need not solve a large equation to follow the idea: connected points influence each other's positions.

segments.title: Push away from the centre
segments.text: Next, inspect the crowded bins. Movable points in an overfull bin are pushed away from its centre. The density weight controls that push.
segments.zh: 接着检查拥挤的区域。超容量区域里的可动点，会被推向远离该区域中心的方向。密度权重控制这股推力的强弱。
segments.en: Next, inspect the crowded bins. Movable points in an overfull bin are pushed away from its centre. The density weight controls that push.

segments.title: Reconnect gently
segments.text: Spreading may lengthen connections, so a light wirelength update follows immediately. Pull and spread have different jobs; one does not replace the other.
segments.zh: 疏散可能让连接变长，所以之后立即接一次轻度的线长更新。拉近与疏散各有任务，不能相互替代。
segments.en: Spreading may lengthen connections, so a light wirelength update follows immediately. Pull and spread have different jobs; one does not replace the other.

segments.title: Twelve rounds
segments.text: The reference performs twelve spread-and-reconnect rounds. These are recorded algorithm states, not the earlier hand-designed motion. Watch both scores at each step.
segments.zh: 参考程序执行十二轮疏散与重新连接。这里展示的是记录下来的算法状态，不是前面手工设计的移动。每一步都要观察两个分数。
segments.en: The reference performs twelve spread-and-reconnect rounds. These are recorded algorithm states, not the earlier hand-designed motion. Watch both scores at each step.

segments.title: A small teaching heuristic
segments.text: This compact procedure illustrates density-aware placement. It is a teaching heuristic, not a complete industrial placer or a guarantee of an optimal solution.
segments.zh: 这个简短流程展示了考虑密度的布局思路。它是教学启发式算法，不是完整工业布局器，也不保证得到最优解。
segments.en: This compact procedure illustrates density-aware placement. It is a teaching heuristic, not a complete industrial placer or a guarantee of an optimal solution.

segments.title: What actually changed?
segments.text: With the default settings, estimated wirelength changes from fifty-two to about forty-eight point one. Overflow starts at two and ends at two.
segments.zh: 在默认设置下，估计线长从五十二变为大约四十八点一。溢出量开始是二，结束时仍然是二。
segments.en: With the default settings, estimated wirelength changes from fifty-two to about forty-eight point one. Overflow starts at two and ends at two.

segments.title: Six points. Four places.
segments.text: Why not zero overflow? Six points share four bins with one place each. At least two points must exceed capacity, whatever positions we choose.
segments.zh: 为什么溢出不能变成零？六个点要放进四个区域，每区只有一个名额。无论怎样选择位置，都至少有两个点超出容量。
segments.en: Why not zero overflow? Six points share four bins with one place each. At least two points must exceed capacity, whatever positions we choose.

segments.title: Check the model first
segments.text: This lower bound counts A and D too. More iterations cannot create missing capacity. Check the model and the available space before blaming the optimiser.
segments.zh: 这个下界也把 A 和 D 算在内。增加迭代并不能凭空增加容量。评价优化器之前，先检查模型和可用空间。
segments.en: This lower bound counts A and D too. More iterations cannot create missing capacity. Check the model and the available space before blaming the optimiser.

segments.title: Compare like with like
segments.text: Keep the netlist, fixed anchors and capacity unchanged when comparing settings. A much smaller score from moving the anchors answers a different question.
segments.zh: 比较不同设置时，要保持网络、固定锚点和容量条件一致。移动锚点后得到的低分，回答的是另一个问题。
segments.en: Keep the netlist, fixed anchors and capacity unchanged when comparing settings. A much smaller score from moving the anchors answers a different question.

segments.title: A parameter is an experiment
segments.text: Try another density weight, then report both outcomes. A stronger push does not promise a better result, and this capacity limit still applies.
segments.zh: 可以尝试另一个密度权重，然后同时报告两项结果。更强的推力不保证更好的结果，刚才的容量下界也仍然适用。
segments.en: Try another density weight, then report both outcomes. A stronger push does not promise a better result, and this capacity limit still applies.

segments.title: Take this scene into the lab
segments.text: Pause the video and take its exact layout into the lab. The workbench keeps the right capacity, and our companion reads the same metrics.
segments.zh: 暂停视频，把这一刻的布局带进实验室。工作台会保留正确的容量，科学家搭档也会读取同一组指标。
segments.en: Pause the video and take its exact layout into the lab. The workbench keeps the right capacity, and our companion reads the same metrics.

segments.title: Predict. Move. Compare.
segments.text: First predict the effect of one move. Then drag a point and compare. If the scores do not change, ask which box or bin stayed unchanged.
segments.zh: 先预测移动一个点会带来什么影响，再动手拖动并比较。如果分数没变，就想想哪个包围盒或者区域计数没有改变。
segments.en: First predict the effect of one move. Then drag a point and compare. If the scores do not change, ask which box or bin stayed unchanged.

segments.title: Replay the reference
segments.text: In reference mode, step through the actual loop or change its density weight. Reset to the same starting layout for a fair comparison.
segments.zh: 在参考实验模式中，可以逐步执行真实循环，也可以改变密度权重。比较时，要重置到相同的初始布局。
segments.en: In reference mode, step through the actual loop or change its density weight. Reset to the same starting layout for a fair comparison.

segments.title: Explain your choice
segments.text: The exercises ask you to measure a net, count overflow, choose a feasible layout, and explain why the default experiment cannot reach zero overflow.
segments.zh: 配套习题会请你计算一个网络的线长、数出溢出量、选择满足容量的布局，并解释默认实验为何不能达到零溢出。
segments.en: The exercises ask you to measure a net, count overflow, choose a feasible layout, and explain why the default experiment cannot reach zero overflow.

segments.title: Connections and space
segments.text: Placement gives a circuit its physical arrangement. Connection length matters, available space matters, and a useful result must be read under its actual constraints.
segments.zh: 布局为电路安排物理位置。连接长度重要，可用空间也重要。理解一个结果，必须结合它实际采用的约束。
segments.en: Placement gives a circuit its physical arrangement. Connection length matters, available space matters, and a useful result must be read under its actual constraints.

segments.title: Your next good question
segments.text: Keep asking two questions: are the connections shorter, and do the points have enough room? Then test your answer. The studio is yours.
segments.zh: 始终记住两个问题：连接有没有变短？这些点有没有足够的空间？然后亲手验证你的判断。现在，工作室交给你。
segments.en: Keep asking two questions: are the connections shorter, and do the points have enough room? Then test your answer. The studio is yours.
